messages.text: The current official/snapshot comparison is resolved: direct official and candidate outputs are byte-identical for the applicable repository cases, while historical snapshots differ because symlink extraction and newline normalization changed. The completion audit still identifies a few source-level edge cases not yet covered—nanosecond full-ISO timestamps, type-sort ordering, quoting apostrophes, Unicode grid width, and real symlink rendering—so I’m closing those before treating the 75-case pass as final.
